Neuropsychological testing revealed attention deficits, disability of encoding visual contents, adjustment disorder, and depression. The patient was diagnosed with suspected Bickerstaff encephalitis and questionable seizures. Following these episodes, his gait became disturbed with occasional falls due to increased ataxia.
